name: Troglodyte Cleric 6
body:
Troglodyte Cleric 6
CR 6

XP 2,400
Male troglodyte cleric 6
CE Medium humanoid (reptilian)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 90 ft.; Perception +5; Aura evil, stench (30 ft., DC 15, 10 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 13, flat-footed 26 (+7 armor, +3 deflection, +6 natural)
hp 74 (8d8+38)
Fort +12, Ref +4, Will +8

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee +1 greataxe +9 (1d12+4/x3)
Special Attacks battle rage 6/day (+3 damage), channel negative energy 3/day (3d6, DC 13), destructive smite 6/day (+3 damage)
Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 6th; concentration +9)

3rd— blindness/deafness (DC 16), rage B, cure serious wounds, dispel magic
2nd— cure moderate wounds (2), hold person (DC 15), resist energy, shatter B (DC 15)
1st— command (DC 14), cure light wounds, divine favor, true strike B, shield of faith
0th(at will)— create water, guidance, mending, stabilize
B denotes domain spell; Domains Destruction, War

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 11, Con 18, Int 8, Wis 16, Cha 10
Base Atk +5; CMB +7; CMD 20
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (greataxe)
Skills Knowledge (Religion) +4, Linguistics +4, Perception +5, Stealth +3 (+7 in rocky areas); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth (+8 in rocky areas)
Languages Common, Draconic
SQ spontaneous casting (inflict spells)
Combat Gear wand of spiritual weapon (37 charges) Other Gear +1 breastplate, +1 greataxe

ECOLOGY

Environment underground
Organization solitary
Treasure His collection of “treasures” consists primarily of dented brass and tin objects such as cups, plates, old incense holders, candelabras, and other such bric-a-brac, most of it badly tarnished, dented, and in poor condition. A careful DC 20 Search check reveals a few more valuable pieces including a dented brass canteen inlaid with silver trimming worth 200 gp, a gold bracelet inlaid with turquoise stone worth 500 gp, and a decorative golden helmet inlaid with a few small pieces of quartz worth 900 gp.
